cards.mood: The piece opens with a solemn, reflective atmosphere that gradually builds in intensity through the verses.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic anchor, playing arpeggiated figures in the intro and verses, transitioning to full, resonant chords in the choruses.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the golden valley meets the sky
Every stone holds a story told
Walking where the ancient rivers flow
Watching the morning colors unfold

Under the canopy of the stars
A land of promise, a heart of fire
Healing the shadows and the scars
[Verse]
Seeds of hope in the fertile ground
Echoes of voices in the wind
A tapestry woven in threads of gold
Where the spirit and the earth are pinned

Rise like the mountains, stand tall
Under the canopy of the stars
A land of promise, a heart of fire
Healing the shadows and the scars
[Bridge]
The horizon calls our names
A symphony of light remains
[Chorus]
Rise like the mountains, stand tall
Under the canopy of the stars
A land of promise, a heart of fire
Healing the shadows and the scars
[Outro]
